split_reasoning: Studying economic and statistical data is one analytical activity across different specialties.

split_reasoning: Economic advice is given both in live consultations and in written responses prepared outside a live contact.

split_reasoning: Recommendations, policies, and plans are alternative forms of a proposed response to an economic issue.

split_reasoning: Developing guidelines or standards and preparing economic points of view produce different kinds of document.

split_reasoning: Legislation, taxes, services, and regulations are policy subjects studied through the same impact-analysis activity.

split_reasoning: Explaining policy impacts to the public can take place in live presentations or through written explanations prepared outside a live interaction.
